插件返回的坐标格式不正确，请重启 CAD 加载新版。: The plug-in returned an invalid point. Restart AutoCAD to load the matching version.
无法创建标号字体样式。: Could not create the callout text style.
\n请输入数字或英文字母，例如 123、A、A01；最多32个字符，不接受空编号: Use 1-32 letters or digits, for example 123, A or A01. Empty labels and spaces are not allowed.
图层已关闭、冻结或锁定，请先启用并解锁。: layer is off, frozen or locked. Turn it on, thaw and unlock it first.
无法创建标号图层。: Could not create the callout layer.
无法创建数字文字样式。: Could not create the legacy text style.
无法计算数字宽度，请检查文字字体。: Could not measure the label. Check the text font.
编号位置离指向点太近，数字会遮挡指向点，请重新选择位置。: The label is too close to the target point. Choose another label position.
无法创建标号块。: Could not create the callout block.
无法创建标号折线。: Could not create the callout leader.
无法创建编号属性定义。: Could not create the label attribute definition.
无法结束标号块定义。: Could not finish the callout block definition.
编号只能包含数字或英文字母，最多32个字符。: Use 1-32 ASCII letters or digits for the label.
无法插入标号块。: Could not insert the callout block.
无法创建编号文字。: Could not create the label attribute.
无法结束编号属性。: Could not finish the label attribute sequence.
所选对象不是本插件创建的标号。: The selected object is not a PatentLabel callout.
标号的编号属性丢失。: The callout NUMBER attribute is missing.
标号数据版本不支持。: This callout data version is not supported.
无法更新编号文字。: Could not update the label text.
请先将 UNDO 控制设置为 All（全部），再使用标号。: Set UNDO Control to All before creating or editing callouts.
\n单次标号：指向点 → 编号位置 → 输入编号 → 确认结束；再次按空格由 C: One callout: target point -> label position -> label -> confirm to finish. Press Space again to repeat BH.
\n数字位置离指向点太近，本条未生成，请重新点取。: The label is too close to the target. No callout was created; pick again.
请选择本工具创建的标号。: Select a callout created by PatentLabel.
\n选择要改为黑体并调整字重的已有标号:: Select callouts to change to Arial and set their weight:
\n所选编号已改为黑体并更新字重，引线粗细保持不变。: Selected labels now use Arial with the chosen weight. Leader lineweight is unchanged.
\n选择要修改编号的标号（引线或数字）:: Select a callout to edit (leader or label):
请选择由 BH 创建的完整标号块。: Select a complete callout block created by BH.
标号已删除或不在当前图纸中。: The callout was deleted or is not in the current drawing.
\nBH：单次标号；BHSZ：字高/折线/间隙/确认键/字重；BHXG：改号；B: BH: create one callout. BHSZ: height/landing/gap/confirmation/weight. BHXG: edit label. BHJC: change label font and weight.
\n确认编号即结束命令；再次空格/回车由 CAD 重复 BH，仍保留下一编号建议: Confirm the label to finish. Press Space/Enter again to repeat BH with the next suggested label. Use U at the command prompt to undo.
\n数字点击位置为中心；默认无箭头，左右自动折线；使用当前 UCS 平面和当前空: The second point is the label center. No arrowhead; the leader bends left/right automatically. Uses the current UCS and space.
\n专利附图标号 0.4.0 已加载。输入 BH 开始，BHSZ 设置，BHHE: PatentLabel 0.4.0 loaded (English). Type BH to start, BHSZ for settings, BHHELP for help.
\n整条折线随鼠标预览已启用；BHXG 在命令行修改编号。: Full leader preview is enabled. Use BHXG to edit labels at the command line.
\n当前为基础模式；NETLOAD 加载配套 PatentLabel.UI.dl: Basic mode. NETLOAD the matching PatentLabel assembly to enable full leader preview.
\n选择要移动编号位置的标号（引线或数字）:: Select a callout to reposition (leader or label):
\n单击标号，拖动编号中心的蓝色夹点，整条引线实时跟随，零件端不动；BHYD 也: Select a callout and drag its blue label-center grip for live leader preview with a fixed target. BHYD is also available.
>：输入新编号后空格/Enter 确认，或直接点下一处指向点；Esc 结束:: >: type a replacement then Space/Enter, or click the next leader target; Esc finishes:
\n新编号会遮挡引线指向点，请输入较短编号，或按空格保留当前编号。: The new label would overlap the target. Type a shorter label, or press Space to keep the current one.
\n连续标号：点指向点 → 点编号位置；可输入编号后空格确认，或直接点下一处；E: Continuous callouts: target -> label center; type a label then Space, or click the next target. Esc finishes and keeps placed callouts.
\nBH：连续标号；BHSZ：字高/折线/间隙/改号确认键/字重；BHXG：改号: BH: continuous callouts. BHSZ: height/landing/gap/BHXG confirmation/weight. BHXG: edit label. BHJC: change font and weight.
\n第二次点击后编号已放好；输入新编号后空格/Enter 确认，或直接点下一处指: The second click places the label. Type a replacement then Space/Enter, or click the next target. Esc finishes; U undoes one callout at the command prompt.
